BentBox Comics: An eCommerce Project by Xylo Solutions

Entertainment and comic brand redesigned to boost engagement, improve conversions, and create a bold digital storefront.

Project showcase

BentBox Comics is a dynamic entertainment brand offering comic books, collectibles, events, and original creative content for passionate fans. Xylo Solutions partnered with the brand to deliver a bold full website redesign focused on stronger engagement, smoother shopping, and higher conversions. As a modern shopify website design company, we transformed the storefront into an immersive digital experience that matches the energy and personality of the brand.

The project included a complete homepage redesign, upgraded product merchandising, and improved category navigation across comics, games, animation, and event content. Product pages were optimized with stronger visual hierarchy, clearer call to actions, and faster browsing paths to help visitors discover and purchase featured releases with ease. As an experienced shopify web design company, we also enhanced mobile responsiveness and content flow to ensure the store performs across every device.

To support long term growth, we implemented CRO strategy, conversion focused layouts, and stronger storytelling sections that keep users engaged while guiding them toward purchase. Promotional banners, featured collections, and community driven sections were structured to improve retention and customer interaction. This reflects the quality of a results driven shopify website design agency delivering premium shopify web design services and strategic shopify design services for brands that blend commerce with entertainment. The final result is a high converting storefront built for fandom, growth, and repeat traffic.
